readerQuestion: What should I inspect when reducing a downloaded video file for sharing?

applicableClaims.name: SpicyBox Terms of Use, sections 2, 4, 5 and 7.2
applicableClaims.note: Read the current PDF. It requires eligible adults to upload only themselves, warns of generated distortions, and distinguishes private templates from reviewed public templates and their covers. No generation or quality result is claimed.

applicableClaims.name: Adobe Express MP4 compression guidance
applicableClaims.note: The compression slider estimates output size; stronger compression may introduce blur or distortion. Marketing quality and processing-time assurances are not adopted.
